about_short_description.short_description: Multis is a crypto treasury management tool designed for web3 organizations.

product.name: Multi-signature Smart Contract Wallets
product.description: Smart contract wallets requiring multiple approvals to execute transactions, enabling shared control and security of crypto assets for organizations.

product.name: On-chain and Off-chain Data Aggregation
product.description: A system that collects and merges blockchain transaction data with off-chain financial data to provide a comprehensive view of crypto and fiat transactions.

product.name: Fiat USD Business Accounts
product.description: Business accounts that enable crypto companies to convert cryptocurrencies to USD and manage fiat funds with faster approval and streamlined processes.
